[/size]
[/b]This mod is [b]NOT[/b] a mega pack of HxW mods.

For this mod to work and be populated, you must go install the HxW furniture mods of your choosing.
You can find a visual list with all compatible mods here: [url=https://himetarts.wixsite.com/artsite/services-9]H&W Catalogue[/url]﻿
